column3: NASB capitalizes “Spirit”; “strive with” renders an uncertain verb, which some take as “remain in,” and “nevertheless” renders “and.”
“the records of the generations” renders “the toledot,” and “in his time” renders “in his generations.”
“gopher wood” is an unknown tree, and “rooms” renders “nests.”
“a window” renders “tsohar,” an uncertain word that may mean “a roof.”
